method.name: Exact complete XOR-to-CNF support/sign parity recognition + classical Gaussian elimination over GF(2)
method.source_witness: For every support size k<=6 require exactly 2^(k-1) unique clause-falsifying assignments, all of identical blocked parity; all source clauses covered by completed groups
method.scientific_explanation: Standard Lights-out 25x25 GF2 linear puzzle; 529 interior length5, 92 edge length4, four corner length3 XOR equations exactly match 9216 clauses and 45312 literals; unlike prior 004D0 two-clause resolution

claim_boundaries: New result is a correct SAT model for one original public third-party CNF from a narrow algebraic family, not general SAT superiority.
0.051-0.053 seconds measure standalone GF2+model checking only, excluding source acquisition and interpreter startup; NOT matched full pipeline time.
Prior raw CDCL was 6-second CPU-censored on the same formula, so no numerical speedup ratio can be computed.
Native strong specialized parity/XOR-aware baselines, a baseline standalone GF(2), and standard solver built-in preprocessing are not yet compared.
Green-Tao was correctly declined as nonexact-XOR, and not solved.
The proof code and repeat hosts remain in the same GitHub administrative trust domain; third-party independent Witness not achieved.
Training/development sources are previously observed, public and not an external sealed hidden exam.
Full production C023 and main remain untouched. P vs NP remains open.
